description: The cortex's catalogue of code paths it knows how to author replacements for. Each entry is a CodeTarget graph node carrying source path, requirements (consumed by language picker), design_tags (consumed by pattern picker), and bench spec (consumed by perf comparison). Extending the cortex to a new target = adding an entry here; no Python edit.

targets.notes: term.rs is 2700+ lines of pyo3-tagged Rust; no benchmark surface registered yet.
Already replaced once (memchr + FxHash); a calibrated benchmark surface would enable further iteration.
Small demo target; tags include precomputable + small_input_domain so the lookup_table design pattern outranks algorithmic_substitution.

The agent's own perception op (run_categorical_perception in pipeline_runtime.rs): clusters continuous A1 patch-response vectors into discrete Phoneme categories by cosine distance. Computationally this is fuzzy classification of a continuous vector into a category — the honest shape tags let the agent's pick_design_pattern see whether an NN recipe fits. Registering the op does NOT decide that it does; the agent's ranking does.
The agent's own recognition op: matches an acoustic-sign trajectory against learned word signatures by distance. Fuzzy classification over a sequence — honest shape tags, agent decides the recipe.
